events.outcome: The legacy 90-day recharge and recycle timing could not be independently reverified against current 2026 Claro pages in this round. Preserve it only as a HOLD signal, not a current-guaranteed rule.

The old BRL15/90 days and BRL60/year normalization is not the currently listed recharge product. Current provider table specifies BRL35/90 days; four recharges are BRL140 for 360 days, with no verified total acquisition cost.

Claro cancellation FAQ uses both '90 days after the last recharge' and '90 days of validity of the last recharge' language; a later 180-day reassignment risk is a separate after-deactivation event, NOT a guaranteed credit-validity or usable-service period.

Claro explicitly states prepaid and Controle subscribers do not have international roaming and must change to a postpaid product. Free inbound international SMS stated on postpaid roaming terms does not apply to this prepaid route.

Claro's current eSIM FAQ supports a foreign passport for prepaid eSIM but only at physical stores; online access is not proof of foreign offshore-first onboarding. Independent January 2026 tourist reports a Claro shop refusing passport activation.

One user complained on 2026-02-19 of buying Claro prepaid eSIM but being unable to first-activate from Portugal, with support indicating physical Brazil presence was needed. One report, not a universal probability.

A June 2026 self-identified Claro prepaid user outside Brazil reported no international roaming and inability to switch their line to postpaid remotely. Independently corroborates provider restriction without an app-specific success percentage.

data.acquisitionSummary: Claro Prezão is a real Brazilian prepaid plan with physical SIM and eSIM. Current lowest total new-number price is unverified; older BRL10 SIM baseline is not suitable for a current quote. Plan package term and recharge credit validity differ.

keep.action: Official prepaid recharge BRL35 is valid 90 days; also BRL50/120 days and BRL100/180 days. Four BRL35 refills cost BRL140 over 360 days, not an exact 365-day guarantee. Refill within 90 days conservatively. Claro's cancellation FAQ ambiguously states both 90 days from last recharge and 90 days after its credit expiry; do not assume an extra recoverable grace interval. Later reassignment after disconnection is a separate risk.

data.chinaActivation: Claro prepaid activates with digital identity checks after receiving SMS/*552; foreign users without CPF must activate via a physical Brazilian Claro store using a passport or RNE. New eSIM first activation from outside Brazil is not established and a Portugal user reported failure.
data.kyc: Claro requires subscriber identity verification. Its prepaid eSIM FAQ permits foreign passport or RNE at physical stores, while independent travelers report store-level refusals.
data.payment: Claro provides app/site, *555#, banks and physical recharge channels. Foreign-issued card acceptance and ongoing account access from overseas are unverified.
data.wifiCalling: Not validated as an overseas prepaid SMS alternative.
data.roamingSms: Claro states international roaming is unavailable for PREPAID or Controle subscriptions; only eligible postpaid customers have roaming. Free roaming inbound SMS described for postpaid cannot be inferred for prepaid. Independent users reported no overseas prepaid SMS/roaming. Not suitable for overseas OTP.
data.refund: No verified prepaid credit refund or recovery guarantee after cancellation.
data.holdReason: HOLD: no international roaming on Claro Prepaid, foreign passport activation requires a Brazil store, offshore-first eSIM failed in one report; exact lifecycle grace and foreign payments remain uncertain.
data.tariffSummary: BRL35/90-day recharge (BRL140 per 360 days); BRL50/120 days; BRL100/180 days. International prepaid roaming unavailable.
guideSteps: Activate in Brazil with approved identity verification; foreigners should use Claro store with passport/RNE.
Recharge by the provider's current 90-day conservative deadline; verify line status and top-up before any lapse.
Do not depend on Claro prepaid for overseas SMS or bank verification: Claro says prepaid has no international roaming.
